mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sys_user (tenant_id, username, display_name, role, password_hash, salt) VALUES (#{tenantId}, #{username}, #{displayName}, 'admin', #{passwordHash}, #{salt})
mapper.select: SELECT id AS "id", username AS "username", display_name AS "displayName", role AS "role", password_hash AS "passwordHash", salt AS "salt", enabled AS "enabled" FROM sys_user WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND username = #{username}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO audit_log (tenant_id, occurred_at, user_id, username, action, entity_type, entity_id, before, after, ip, result) VALUES (#{tenantId}, now(), #{userId,jdbcType=BIGINT}, #{username}, #{action}, #{entityType}, #{entityId,jdbcType=BIGINT}, #{before,jdbcType=VARCHAR}::jsonb, #{after,jdbcType=VARCHAR}::jsonb, #{ip,jdbcType=VARCHAR}::inet, #{result})
mapper.select: SELECT c.code AS "capability", r.seq AS "seq", r.method AS "method", r.sample_count AS "sampleCount" FROM capability_recipe r JOIN capability c ON c.id = r.capability_id WHERE r.tenant_id = #{param1} ORDER BY c.code, r.seq
